product_one_liner.value: SurveySparrow is an AI-powered customer-experience platform that helps organizations collect feedback through conversational surveys and other channels, analyze it, and turn insights into action.

hq_location.notes: The current company profile and corporate-office listing identify San Francisco; some press releases retain Palo Alto.

eng_blog.notes: Developer-authored posts explain the PostgreSQL migration and the engineering team’s SLO/reliability implementation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable jobs board lists 11 open roles, none with a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title. The official careers URL could not be read; this assessment relies on the third-party board.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Azure OpenAI; Anthropic Claude Sonnet via Amazon Bedrock
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor policy names OpenAI and Azure OpenAI; the AWS customer case study identifies Claude Sonnet for summarization, clustering and sentiment scoring. This is not an exhaustive feature-by-feature model inventory.

compliance_certs.notes: Public compliance claims include SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022. HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims, not equivalent to independent certification. PCI compliance is attributed to the payment processor, not SurveySparrow itself.

last_funding.notes: The company announcement is datelined April 2, 2019, despite a 2026 page header. Its reported amount is $1.4 million; a funding database instead records November 2018, so the announcement date is used.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round is the April 2019 seed announcement, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Business Development Representative - US; the dated job listing was verified November 5, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: SurveySparrow announced the launch of Echo, its real-time conversational feedback AI agent, on September 17, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Vipin Thomas’s profile dates his VP Revenue Operations & Strategy role at SurveySparrow through June 2026 and his next role at Freshworks from June 2026, establishing a VP departure inside November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and ZoomInfo appear as example tools in sales hiring requirements. The other names appear in integrations documentation/catalogs. These are visible stack signals, not proof of internal deployment.
